init_SawyerPickOutOfHoleEnv: create a SawyerPickOutOfHoleEnv instance to initialize the pick out of hole MuJoCo robot environment
step_SawyerPickOutOfHoleEnv: run a single environment step with an action and get observation, reward, and success info
reset_model_SawyerPickOutOfHoleEnv: reset the SawyerPickOutOfHoleEnv model to initial state with optional random object and goal positions
compute_reward_SawyerPickOutOfHoleEnv: compute the reward signal combining reach, pick, and place rewards for the current state
reset_hand_SawyerPickOutOfHoleEnv: reset the robot hand to initial position and compute finger center of mass
